extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and research administrators preparing applications to NERC / UKRI funding opportunities (UK-based research organisations)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for applying to specific NERC / UKRI funding opportunities (eligibility, partnership requirements, funding levels, and deadlines). Targets environmental-science research applicants based at UK research organisations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Host organisation eligibility (Seedcorn Fund)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for NERC funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a mandatory eligibility requirement for the Environmental sciences: Global Partnerships Seedcorn Fund 2026; applicants should ensure their employing/host institution appears on NERC-eligible lists before applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory international project partners (Seedcorn Fund)
rubrics_metrics.description: The inclusion of one or more international project partners is mandatory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must include at least one international partner organisation (outside the UK). Ensure partner roles and contributions are described in the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding type and limits (Seedcorn Fund)
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding type: Grant. Total fund: £1,000,000. Maximum award: £100,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should request awards up to the stated maximum and align budgets with the grant funding model; total call budget is £1,000,000.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application window and deadlines (Seedcorn Fund)
rubrics_metrics.description: Opening date: 5 May 2026 9:00am UK time. Closing date: 16 July 2026 4:00pm UK time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be submitted within this window and by the exact UK-time closing timestamp; plan institutional approvals and submission well before the deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invite-only requirement (UKRI metascience scientometrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This opportunity is not open to unsolicited applications; only those sent an invitation may submit. Check for invitation notices before preparing an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding level and contribution basis (UKRI metascience scientometrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to £3 million at 80% full economic cost (FEC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should prepare budgets on an 80% FEC basis and justify costs accordingly; total available funding for the competition is up to £3,000,000.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application window and deadlines (UKRI metascience scientometrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Opening date: 28 April 2026 9:00am UK time. Closing date: 2 June 2026 4:00pm UK time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Observe the stated opening and closing timestamps; only invited applicants may submit within this window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Co-funders and cross-council involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: This opportunity lists multiple funders/co-funders (e.g., UK Research and Innovation, ESRC, NERC, BBSRC, AHRC, STFC, EPSRC, MRC; co-funders include DSIT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The presence of multiple funders may imply cross-council priorities, expectations, or reporting requirements; applicants should check call-specific guidance for funder-specific conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: General funding metadata (applies to listed opportunities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each opportunity specifies publication date, opening/closing dates, funding type, total fund and maximum award (where applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat these metadata items as part of call requirements: ensure eligibility, budget requests, and submission timing conform to the published metadata for the specific opportunity.
